items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And we remain to this day very dear friends.

ctx.x: And how long did -- did Neal -- you said that Neal wrote for you then too, didn't you?

Well, Neal joined my band as a trumpet player at first, in 1942. And of course he started writing for me then, and he would up with Woody too. But then he was back off and on, different times, playing and arranging before he got into his own thing. And we remain to this day very dear friends. In fact I just spoke to him the day before yesterday.
